newsitem.title: DUBAI: Saudi beheads Nigerian for smuggling drugs.
newsitem.headline: Saudi beheads Nigerian for smuggling drugs.

text.p: Saudi Arabia on Friday beheaded a Nigerian man for smuggling drugs into the kingdom, raising to 57 the number of executions this year in the conservative Islamic country.
An interior ministry statement carried by the official Saudi Press Agency said the Nigerian man was beheaded in Jeddah after being convicted of smuggling cocaine and hashish.

The execution brought to 18 the number of people put to death in Saudi Arabia on drugs charges in the past two months. The kingdom enforces Islamic sharia law by publicly beheading convicted murderers, rapists, drug smugglers and other criminals. It executed a total of 68 people in 1996.
